purpose: Add the two fixed H1 relative-context features as context to an isolated shadow evaluator while leaving the active V2R3 baseline unchanged.

candidate_stream.source: same canonical handoff_queue candidates as active V2R3

fixed_features.target_return_1h_pct: candidate scanner_candidate.ret1h at the candidate event
fixed_features.leader_median_return_1h_pct: median of XBT/EUR and ETH/EUR 1h returns from the same point-in-time scan snapshot when available
fixed_features.peer_median_return_1h_pct: median 1h return of all eligible same-snapshot Kraken EUR peers excluding the target

pilot_gate.low_impact_rule: If fewer than 5 baseline-vs-H1 decision divergences occur by the minimum gate, classify the pilot INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_IMPACT; do not tune or extend automatically.

cost_reference.note: Same conservative V2R3 reference. Pilot shadow decisions do not authorize real orders.
